document_info.requirement_name: Single chart for monthly defect-rate monitoring

background.summary: Quality managers need one trusted chart to monitor monthly defect rate by plant, product family, and defect category. Current reports are manually prepared and definitions are inconsistent.
background.objective: Deliver a single interactive chart with confirmed data contract, filters, detail table, export, and permission rules.

core_scenarios: User filters by plant and month.
User hovers over a point to see numerator and denominator.
User clicks a month to inspect detail records.

functional_requirements.overview: This default example includes Chart rendering, Filter and detail table, Export and permission control.

business_rules: Only authorized roles can view scoped data and perform sensitive actions.
Core business actions must keep an audit trail.
Exported data must follow the same filters and permission scope as the page.
Data refresh status and calculation definitions must be visible to users.

interaction_flow: User filters by plant and month.
User hovers over a point to see numerator and denominator.
User clicks a month to inspect detail records.

risks_and_notes: Metric ownership and data definitions must be confirmed.
Historical data quality may affect acceptance.
External system readiness may affect rollout scope.
acceptance_criteria: The example scope can be generated into PRD and design documents.
Users can revise the seeded requirement through chat messages.
Main roles, flows, data, permissions, and acceptance criteria are represented.
